title: Story premise ENT120: The Community Noticeboard’s Empty Square
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: The smallest request is under the largest headline. Takeaway/theme: A shared information space can make modest requests visible.
description: A neighborhood noticeboard fills with competing oversized announcements, hiding a small request for spare drawing paper. A volunteer gives each notice an equal marked square and reserves one clearly labeled REQUESTS area; the final square receives a bundle of donated blank paper and a tiny original thank-you sketch.
